messages.subject: Thai Solar Energy | Renewable growth, partnerships and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Thai Solar Energy Leadership Team,

Thai Solar Energy's portfolio across utility-scale solar, rooftop solar and private PPA solutions aligns directly with the energy-transition work I support today.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities cover government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

My recent work includes stakeholder and governance support around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, together with carbon-data readiness and regulator coordination. I understand the operating, institutional and stakeholder requirements behind renewable deployment.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across External Affairs, Sustainability, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or country strategy. I have attached a Thai Solar Energy-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
